title: 3. The History of Coffee (V ou F)

content.text: Coffee was originally discovered in Ethiopia by a goat herder named Kaldi, who noticed his goats became very energetic after eating berries from a certain tree. Today, coffee is one of the most popular drinks worldwide, with millions of cups consumed daily. Brazil is the largest producer of coffee in the world, exporting thousands of tons every year.

statements.statement: Coffee was first discovered in Brazil.
A goat herder noticed the effects of coffee berries first.
Brazil is currently the world's leading producer of coffee.
